name: Mille Jowar Puff
ingredients_raw: Puff 88%: Supergrain Blend (Jowar, Foxtail Millet, Corn, Rice)(72%), Rice Bran Oil (16%). Seasoning 12%: Vegetables and Spices (Onion, Garlic, Tomato, Chilli, Amchur, Tamarind), Salt, Natural and Nature Identical Flavours, Raw Sugar, Acidity Regulators (INS330, INS296, INS334), Potassium Chloride - Salt Substitute (INS 508). Rosemary Extract - Antioxidant (INS 392).
